name: Amaguni Hitoya
source: A skilled lawyer with clear principles. He will take on any case so long as there’s a chance to win, no matter how much money is involved. On the other hand, he despises bullying as it led to his brother’s death, so he accepts consultations and requests from victims of bullying without compensation. He has suffered in the past, but with the help of his friends, he’s been able to move forward.
